rows.en: Don't tell me he's after the King Stone!!
It's almost time... At last, the King Stone will be mine...
...Do this if you like, but my comrades will defeat you, I swear it!!
Comrades...? Ah, you mean them.
Unfortunately, my enhanced soldiers should have finished them off by now.
What did you say...!?
That's as far as you go!!
That's as far as you go!!
That's as far as you go!!
That's as far as you go!!
That's as far as you go!!
That's as far as you go!!
That's as far as you go!!
That's as far as you go!!
That's as far as you go!!
I knew you'd be here!
What...!? You mean you defeated those two...
But can those weakened bodies of yours withstand this!?
Wh... What is this!!
Wh... What is this!!
Wh... What is this!!
Wh... What is this!!
Wh... What!? What is this...!!
Wh... What is this!!
Wh... What the heck is this...
Wh... What is this!!
Wh... What is this!!
Well? How do you like the taste of my "Shutdown Beam"?
Damn it!! I can't move!!
Damn it!! I can't move!!
Damn it!! I can't move!!
Damn it!! I can't move!!
Damn it!! I can't move!!
Damn it!! I can't move!!
Dammit!! I can't freakin' move!!
Ugh!! I... I can't move!!
Dammit!! I can't budge!!
Tch!! ...Pulling a cheap stunt like this, you bastard!!
Heh heh heh, hahahaha...!! The Crisis Empire's technology isn't half bad after all!
The "Shutdown Beam"... the very thing that once left Black RX unable to transform,
a fearsome technology of the Crisis Empire.
And now, I shall extract the King Stone from RX's body.
You should feel honored to witness the moment of the century, heroes!
Stop iiit!! I said stop iiiiit!!
I think not. The King Stone will bring great benefits to our future.
The preparations for it are already underway. Look, these are the fruits of my research.
A semi-perpetual engine that far surpasses even the GN Drive...
Used as the medium for a Colony Laser, it would have the power to destroy a planet.
...Th... The Earth is in danger!!
...Th... The Earth is in danger!!
...Th... The Earth is in danger!!
...Th... The Earth is in danger!!
...Th... The Earth is in danger!!
...The Earth... is in danger!!
...Th... The Earth's in big trouble!!
...Th... The Earth is in danger!!
...Th... The Earth's in trouble!!
Heh heh heh, hahahaha...!! Perhaps I'll test-fire it on your Earth, then?
Is this guy... out of his mind!?
The King Stone doesn't exist for something like that!!
Silence!!
The King Stone shows its true worth only when used by a select few geniuses like us!
You're wrong!!
I, The O, shall show the world the path it must take!!
I won't forgive you... Even if it costs me my life, even if it costs me my body, you at least...!!
I'll never forgive you... even if it costs me my life!!
I won't forgive you!! I'll eradicate all that breeds conflict!!
I'll never forgive you! ...I'll act on my emotions!!
Unforgivable! I won't forgive you!!
Don't screw with us! I won't forgive you!!
You bastard... I've heard enough of your mouth!! I can't stand guys like you!!
Unforgivable! I won't forgive you!!
Unforgivable!! I'll never, ever forgive you!!
Laying your raw emotions bare like that...!!
Uwaah!!
Tch!!
Ugh!!
Kh!!
Waaah!!
Whoa...!!

notes.note: Last party variant (Zero) of the 'King Stone' line from story_040 (0.81-0.114 cycle of four lines per party leader).

Party-variant order in 0256 (9 heroes), inferred from signature lines here and in story_042 (0.108-0.116): pos0 Zeta Gundam (Kamille's 'even if it costs my life/body' at 0.67, 'disappear from here' at 042 0.108), pos1 Nu Gundam, pos2 00, pos3 Wing Zero, pos4 OOO, pos5 W, pos6 Den-O Sword Form, pos7 Mebius ('boku'), pos8 Zero. The extractor's 'Zero' label on pos0 rows (0.7, 0.19, 0.30, 0.67, 0.77) looks wrong; pos0 is most likely Zeta Gundam.
RX to The O. Source is a concessive 'even if you do this'; rendered 'Do this if you like, but...'.
'Enhanced soldiers' = The O's augmented troops (Bound Doc, Tieren Taozi) from story_040.
Ankh, in the moment the party bursts in; 'yahari' rendered 'I knew you'd be here'.
'Kinou teishi beam' rendered "Shutdown Beam" (term not in glossary; no established English found). Same term in 0.41.
Narration split across 0.41/0.42; cut at the matching point. 'BLACK RX' (with a stray quote mark in source) rendered Black RX.
'Taiyouro' (Solar Furnace) rendered GN Drive, the established 00 English term; earlier slices used both 'GN Drive' and 'Solar Furnace', so a reviewer may want to unify.
No speaker recovered; obviously The O (same laugh as 0.40, threatening the heroes). 'Your Earth' is singular 'kisama', aimed at the party leader.
No speaker recovered; a hero (party leader or Ankh) reacting. Written speaker-neutral.
Kamille's famous line to Scirocco (Zeta Gundam vs The O), so pos0 = Zeta Gundam despite the 'Zero' label. Trailing 'you at least...' kept unfinished as in source.
00 (Setsuna's 'eradicate what breeds conflict'). 0.70 is Wing Zero (Heero's 'act on my emotions').
W variant. 'Fuzakeru na' rendered 'Don't screw with us!' (W is two people).
Den-O Sword Form (Momotaros). 'Iwaseteokeba' = 'I've let you talk and...', rendered 'I've heard enough of your mouth'.
Echo of Scirocco's Zeta line about fighting with raw emotions exposed. The source is a fragment (implied 'it's hopeless'), kept as a fragment as he strikes the heroes.
0.77-0.82 hit cries, pos0-pos5 (Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero, OOO, W); pos6-8 continue in story_042.

report: 80/80 rows. Party-variant order inferred (pos0 likely Zeta Gundam despite 'Zero' label). Speakers inferred: 0.60 The O, 0.61 neutral. Terms not in glossary: King Stone, "Shutdown Beam", GN Drive (vs earlier 'Solar Furnace'), Colony Laser, enhanced soldiers.
